name: Claudia McCunnen
original_name: クロウディア マッキェネン
source:
A mysterious young woman who sits on Inferno's Executive Council.  She has a troubled past that she has all but put behind her and quickly takes a liking to [url=/c26843] 
Zwei[/url]. Her nickname, "Clau" ("Kuro"), means "black" in Japanese.

Weapon of choice: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AMT_Backup]AMT Backup[/url] (.380 automatic Colt Pistol).
